build_seqLSTM_encoder: build a bidirectional LSTM encoder module to embed VRP input sequences as hidden state representations
create_seqLSTM_instance: create a SeqLSTM instance with configurable hidden size, embedding size, num layers, and dropout rate
run_calc_embedding: run calc_embedding on a list of seq_managers to compute LSTM encoder outputs for each route sequence
review_seqLSTM_padding: review the SeqLSTM calc_embedding method and its zero-padding logic for variable-length route sequences
test_seqLSTM_cuda: test the SeqLSTM encoder with cuda flag enabled to verify GPU tensor conversion and forward pass
